newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle quiet, no sales - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle quiet, no sales - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
There were 1,700 head confirmed for the week to date. The last established price was $63.00 per cwt on Friday. Monday's packer bids were $62.00, asking prices mostly $63.00-$64.00.
